channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: PA approves Corinthia Oasis hotel and 25 luxury villas
item.description: Former Ħal Ferħ holiday complex in Għajn Tuffieħa to be transformed into a 161-suite hotel and 25 high-end villas after the Planning Board gave unanimous approval

item.title: PN ups the heat on Robert Abela with billboard quoting Judge Mintoff
item.description: Nationalist Party erects billboard showing Prime Minister Robert Abela next to Lawrence Mintoff quote accusing the Labour leader of prefering money over judicial indpendence

item.title: Authorities consulting Interpol to find Jeremy Harbinson
item.description: Police inspector says an Interpol ‘blue diffusion’ was issued against Jeremy Harbinson to help find him

item.title: Golden Matrix group rebrands to Meridian Holdings Inc.
item.description: Golden Matrix Group has rebranded to Meridian Holdings Inc., adopting the Nasdaq ticker MRDN as it aligns its corporate identity with flagship brand Meridianbet following its recent Malta retail expansion.

item.title: New association calls for shared responsibility in sustainable education
item.description: The Malta Association of Professionals in Education for Sustainable Development (mapESD) says sector is too fragmented and must become a collective effort across all parts of society

item.title: Europa Nostra lists Fort Chambray barracks among Europe’s most endangered
item.description: Din L-Art Ħelwa president Patrick Calleja warns site’s threat comes not from natural disaster but from ‘speculative interests’ seeking private development, criticizing the planned relocation of the barracks’ façade as treating heritage like a ‘theatre stage prop’

item.title: Neville Gafa illegally received medical visa payments from Libyans, court ruling reveals
item.description: Court rejects €36,675 claim by Libyan intermediary over medical visa paymens for Libyan patients since money came from illegal scheme devised by the Libyan man and Neville Gafa • Court says Gafa received 'substantial cash payments'

item.title: Tourist, 19, gets suspended sentence for attempted break-in while drunk
item.description: 19-year-old tourist handed suspended sentence for attempting to break into woman’s home

item.title: Man granted bail over alleged ‘politically motivated’ headbutt in Valletta festa
item.description: Accused granted bail for denying causing grievous bodily harm to another man for ‘no reason’

item.title: European Commission passes choice to member states on abortion access funding
item.description: The European Commission rejects proposal for abortion finance scheme, says existing EU funds can already be used to help women access services abroad
